description: Source code for a GTK-based 'Open With' dialog, allowing users to select or specify applications to open files, including parsing desktop files and managing application list.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents an application with name, executable path, icon, and multiple instance flag.

classes.name: Open_with_data
classes.description: Holds data for the open-with dialog, including dialog widgets, file list, and application list.

methods.name: xa_app_compare
methods.description: Compares two App structures based on their executable and name for sorting and deduplication.

methods.name: xa_app_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an App instance.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_expander_expanded
methods.description: Handles expansion of the custom command expander, setting the command text if expanded.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_selection_changed
methods.description: Updates the custom command entry when a different application is selected.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_execute_command
methods.description: Launches the selected or entered application with the specified files and closes the dialog.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_row_selected
methods.description: Executes the command when a row in the application list is activated.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_custom_entry_activated
methods.description: Executes the command when the custom command entry is activated.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_mouse_button_event
methods.description: Handles mouse button events, executing command on middle click.

methods.name: xa_destroy_open_with_dialog
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources when the dialog is destroyed.

methods.name: xa_open_with_dialog_browse_custom_command
methods.description: Opens a file chooser to select a custom application command.

methods.name: xa_parse_desktop_file
methods.description: Parses a desktop file to extract application info and adds it to the application list if valid.

methods.name: xa_read_desktop_directory
methods.description: Reads desktop files from a directory and processes each.

methods.name: xa_create_open_with_dialog
methods.description: Creates and displays the open-with dialog, populating it with applications and handling user interaction.
